tips: 分别记省下的运输费和增加的退货费。

audio.transcript: The supplier introduced lighter packaging to reduce transport costs. However, several customers found that it was damaged more easily, leading to additional replacements. The company is now comparing the savings in delivery with the extra cost of returned goods.
